notes: Run of 2026-11-18. Six Mission Local stories queued. One earns an entry: the former Walgreens at 1189 Potrero Avenue is to become a child care center for San Francisco General Hospital staff. The data-center moratorium story names 400 Paul Avenue only as a project the pause would affect; declined. The other four print no street address.

findings.description: The retail space at 1189 Potrero Avenue (24th Street), vacated by Walgreens two years ago, is to be converted into a city child care center for San Francisco General Hospital employees, 53 children from infancy to five; the city began the building-permit process in August, and the lease still needs Board of Supervisors approval. Rendering by Dorman Associates.

citation.label: Mission Local, “Shuttered Mission Walgreens to become San Francisco General Hospital child care center — a move nearly 40 years in the making,” 18 November 2026

raw.text: The center will operate at 1189 Potrero Ave. at 24th Street, the space occupied by Walgreens until the drugstore chain vacated two years ago.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 1189 POTRERO AVE → parcel 4212019; sf-parcels has blklot 4212019 active, 1189–1189 POTRERO; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1997.

publish.note: Entry on /san-francisco/mission/potrero-avenue/1189/ as mission-local-2026-11-18; homepage card added.

findings.description: The supervisors extended the moratorium on new data centers; a planned expansion of a data center at 400 Paul Avenue is named as a project the pause would likely hold up.

citation.label: Mission Local, “S.F. supervisors vote to extend pause on data centers for 10 months,” 17 November 2026

raw.text: A project to expand a data center at 400 Paul Ave would likely pause

publish.note: Declined: a citywide policy story; 400 Paul Avenue appears only as the photo caption's example of a project the moratorium might pause. Nothing happened to the building. SFist, the Standard and the Chronicle covered the same vote and are not filed.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 400 PAUL AVE → parcel 5431A051; sf-parcels has blklot 5431A051 active, 300–400 PAUL; the 2025 roll records it as industrial, built 1930. EAS files the address under parcel 5431A014, which sf-parcels reports retired; the active parcel its coordinates fall in is 5431A051.
